role.zh: 清华大学电子工程系 · 博士生
role.en: Ph.D. student · Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University

bio.zh: 我研究光如何参与计算：从集成光子器件、逆向设计，到面向智能系统的光电协同。也希望在研究之外，为音乐、诗歌和摄影留一处安静的空间。
bio.en: I study how light can compute—from integrated photonic devices and inverse design to photonic–electronic systems for AI. Beyond research, I am making a quiet space for music, poetry, and photography.

researchStatement.zh: 我的兴趣在光子器件与计算系统之间。器件层面，关注如何用物理结构表达目标算子；方法层面，探索生成模型与电磁仿真的结合；系统层面，研究光学计算能为人工智能工作负载承担哪些实际任务。
researchStatement.en: My interests sit between photonic devices and computing systems. At the device level, I explore how physical structures can represent target operators. At the methods level, I connect generative models with electromagnetic simulation. At the systems level, I investigate practical roles for optical computing in AI workloads.
